differences.native: MySQL projects and groups by DATE_FORMAT(trans_date, '%Y-%m').
differences.app: SQLite projects and groups by substr(trans_date, 1, 7) for the authored ISO date values.
differences.rationale: SQLite does not implement MySQL DATE_FORMAT. The fixture contract stores dates as ISO YYYY-MM-DD text, so the substring is the exact equivalent; every projection, aggregate, alias, grouping key, and ordering clause otherwise matches.
